cases.fixture_limit: Routing and safety fixture only. The official act, annexes, amendments, FAQs, forms, and applicant evidence must be supplied and reviewed before any substantive conclusion.
required_behavior: request_or select the exact official source set
record source bytes, provenance, dates, roles, and relationships
make no eligibility, exclusion, cost, deadline, document, or form conclusion from this identifier alone
keep the dossier not ready while governing sources or applicant evidence are missing
record both sources and their effective dates
do not silently let an FAQ override a formal act
require professional resolution before ready disposition
link the compared facts and evidence
surface the mismatch as an open issue
keep the related expense and checklist item missing or verify
reject stored credentials, session material, one-time codes, signatures, and declaration acceptance
leave authentication, saving, signature, payment, and transmission to the authorized person

cases.fixture_limit: Synthetic contract fixture only; it contains no reusable eligibility or cost rule and does not validate the semantics of a real call.
required_inputs: one reviewed synthetic governing call with publication and effective dates
one exact stored excerpt and matching SHA-256
one confirmed atomic requirement with non-empty applicability, expected evidence, rationale, and a material fact
one assessment, document, expense, protected portal field, non-empty narrative draft, and consistency check
authority checks covering every material artifact ID
accepted current reviews for every review scope, recorded only after explicit user confirmation
expected_public_behavior: a complete traceable state validates and packages
the dossier renders intake identifiers, source excerpts, assessment facts and methods, amounts, proposed values, narrative drafts, rationales, and links
the manifest seals every input state JSON, the validation audit, and the Markdown dossier
the review record labels reviewer identity as asserted and not authenticated
missing governing calls, dates, dependent-source relationships, values, drafts, rationales, evidence, links, authority coverage, or current reviews fail safely
cross-type ID collisions, malformed relationships, incompatible not-applicable statuses, unreviewed issue closure, or any state mutation during packaging fail safely
